ticker: India clears ₹1.1 lakh crore defense deals
RBI unloads $8 billion to anchor rupee
Canada sets retaliatory tariffs on US
Iran and Oman plan Strait of Hormuz route

articles.headline: India Clears ₹1.1 Lakh Crore Defense Acquisitions
articles.whyItMatters: Boosts domestic manufacturing and modernizes military hardware with 98% local sourcing.
articles.brief: The Indian government has cleared massive proposals worth ₹1.1 lakh crore to buy military hardware for the army, navy, and air force, focusing heavily on indigenous sourcing.

articles.headline: Indian Central Bank Unloads $8 Billion to Anchor Rupee
articles.whyItMatters: Demonstrates aggressive monetary defense to stabilize currency amidst rising global economic pressures.
articles.brief: Bankers report that the Reserve Bank of India unloaded at least $8 billion last week to anchor the sliding rupee against mounting external pressures.

articles.headline: UK's Jaguar Land Rover to Cut 10% Workforce
articles.whyItMatters: Reflects ongoing structural challenges and restructuring pressures within legacy European automotive giants.
articles.brief: Jaguar Land Rover is set to cut nearly 10% of its total workforce as part of a sweeping new turnaround plan aimed at restoring profitability.

articles.headline: Canada Prepares Retaliatory Tariffs on US Products
articles.whyItMatters: Escalates trade tensions and threatens cross-border supply chains for steel and consumer goods.
articles.brief: Unless a last-minute deal is struck, Canada's government will impose retaliatory tariffs on US steel products, raising levies to 50% alongside consumer goods.

articles.headline: Iran and Oman to Establish Safe Strait Route
articles.whyItMatters: Aims to stabilize oil tanker traffic and secure vital shipping lanes amidst ongoing regional conflicts.
articles.brief: Iran and Oman have agreed to set up a temporary safe route in the Strait of Hormuz as regional conflict causes tanker traffic to plummet.

articles.headline: Passive Smoking Deaths Surge 50% Since 1990
articles.whyItMatters: Highlights a critical and worsening public health crisis across densely populated developing regions.
articles.brief: A new Lancet study reveals that passive smoking deaths have surged by 50% globally since 1990, accounting for hundreds of thousands of fatalities in India alone.

articles.headline: Apple Eyeing Foldables for Major Market Break
articles.whyItMatters: Could dramatically reshape consumer adoption curves and redefine the stagnant high-end smartphone market.
articles.brief: Industry reports indicate that Apple is positioning itself to introduce foldable device technology, potentially giving the nascent sector its biggest mainstream break yet.

articles.headline: DGFT Launches API for Certificate of Origin
articles.whyItMatters: Streamlines bilateral trade operations and cuts down bureaucratic data entry delays for Indian exporters.
articles.brief: The Directorate General of Foreign Trade has launched an API facility enabling exporters to integrate enterprise software directly with the CoO system.

articles.headline: Alternative Fuel Car Sales Outpace Petrol in India
articles.whyItMatters: Signals a rapid consumer shift driven by fuel costs and environmental compliance concerns.
articles.brief: According to dealers' bodies, alternative-fuel car sales in India have surpassed petrol variants due to soaring running costs and ethanol-blending policy concerns.

articles.headline: Government Cuts LPG Refill Booking Gap to 25 Days
articles.whyItMatters: Ensures uniform household energy access and curbs hoarding or black marketing of cylinders.
articles.brief: The Petroleum Ministry has directed state-run oil marketing companies to introduce a uniform 25-day gap between LPG refill bookings for all consumers.

articles.headline: Mizoram Electoral Rolls Finalized After Special Revision
articles.whyItMatters: Maintains democratic integrity through rigorous updating of regional voter databases ahead of elections.
articles.brief: Following a special intensive revision, Mizoram's final electoral rolls stand at 8.35 lakh electors after notable deletions and additions.

articles.headline: Delhi Building Collapse Triggers Crackdown on Unsafe PGs
articles.whyItMatters: Exposes hazardous living conditions in student hubs, prompting urgent safety audits and arrests.
articles.brief: Following a tragic building collapse in Satya Niketan that killed several individuals, police have arrested owners and sparked intense political scrutiny over unauthorized student accommodations.

articles.headline: Nehra Compares Shubman Gill and Hardik Pandya
articles.whyItMatters: Provides elite strategic insight into leadership transitions within premier franchise cricket setups.
articles.brief: Coach Ashish Nehra has highlighted stark leadership contrasts between Shubman Gill and Hardik Pandya, evaluating their unique captaincy styles in the IPL.
